shortDescription: A modern overhaul of RimWorld's dev tools: a debug log that traces errors to the culprit mod and explains them (mod log-prefix tag matching + shipped library + mod-authors' own bundled known-issues.json + About.xml incompat scan + opt-in community DBs), an in-game bug/fix report composer, a 3-tab dev actions window and reskinned palette, plus impact scoring and updated-mod tracking.
body:
## Modern Dev Tools

A modern overhaul of RimWorld's developer tools (Modern Suite). Namespace `ModernDevTools`, assembly `ModernDevTools.dll`, packageId `astryl.ModernDevTools`. C# + Harmony.

### Shared UI (`Palette`)
Dark suite chrome, no `GameFont.Tiny`, sentence case, ASCII, cached Theme.Accent, flat gray scrollbars. Shipped icons in `Textures/UI/DevTools/` via `MdtTex`.
- **`Palette.SearchField(rect, controlName, text, placeholder)`** — suite-styled single-line text/search field: dark BGD well, 1px border that turns Accent while focused, dim placeholder when empty+unfocused, and NO vanilla frame (transparent `GUIStyle` cloned from `GUI.skin.textField` with all state backgrounds stripped, built lazily during OnGUI). Routes the control name through `GUI.SetNextControlName` so keyboard focus never jumps between fields. Used by BOTH the modern log search and the dev-actions search for parity.

### Tool 1: modern debug log (`Window_ModernLog`)
Redirects `UIRoot.CheckOpenLogWindow` + `DebugWindowsOpener.ToggleLogWindow`. Left list (culled) + right inspector. Full parity + Modules button, Ignore, mod links, Update info, Mods-changed indicator. Inspector leads with an **impact banner** (`ImpactAssessor`), and (for errors/warnings) ends with a **Report to the community** card. Search box uses `Palette.SearchField` (not auto-focused — the log auto-opens on launch errors and must not steal the keyboard).

### Analysis modules ("What this means") + extensibility
`ErrorModuleDef`/`ErrorModule`/`ModernDevToolsAPI` + `ErrorContext` (ranks mods, collects diagnoses, cached per message). `Module_StackTrace` (assembly + namespace-ownership attribution via `FrameParser`), `Module_LogPrefix`, `Module_MessageMentions`, `Module_KnownIssues` (~32-entry shipped library), `Module_VersionMismatch`, `Module_Community`, `Module_CommunityBugs`.

**Index prewarm (startup, background thread).** The first error analysis lazily builds `InstalledModIndex` (iterates every installed mod) and `BuildNamespaceRoots` (enumerates every type in every loaded mod assembly). On a large modlist that is a multi-second freeze, and on a launch-time auto-open it lands right as the user reads/closes the log (reported symptom). `Bootstrap` now kicks `InstalledModIndex.Prewarm()` on a background thread at startup (also folds in `KnownIssueIndex.EnsureBuilt`). `InstalledModIndex.Instance`/`Invalidate` are lock-guarded and namespace-root build is behind `EnsureNamespaceRoots()` (own lock), so the prewarm thread and a main-thread analysis coordinate — worst case is one shared build, never a double build.

**Log-prefix attribution (`Module_LogPrefix` + `InstalledModIndex.MatchTag`, always-on).** Many mods stamp a `[ModName]` tag on their own log lines (`[Giddy-Up]`, `[Map Preview v1.12.25]`, `[MeleeAnim]`, `[Map Mode Framework]`); the first line's bracket tags are matched to a single **active** installed mod. `MatchTag`: rejects non-mod tags (`[Ref …]`, `[0x…]`, too-short/number-only), strips a trailing version stamp (`v1.12.25`), normalizes (lowercase ASCII-alnum), then (1) exact-matches against each active mod's normalized name / packageId / packageId-suffix / folder, preferring the sole active owner; (2) falls back to a **unique-shortest-key prefix** match for abbreviations (`MeleeAnim`→`Melee Animation`, not the longer `Melee Animation Vanilla`). Leading tag → `WeightMessagePrefix` (=5, peer to a stack frame; a real stack culprit still ranks above via FirstIndex tiebreak); mid-line tags → `WeightMessageName`. Reasons `MDT_ReasonLogPrefix`/`MDT_ReasonLogMention`.

**Diagnosis source layering (highest first):** (1) **mod-shipped `About/known-issues.json`** → (2) community bug DB (fallback) → (3) shipped library → (4) declared incompatibilities.
- **Mod-shipped known issues (`ModShippedIssues` + `Module_ModIssues`, always-on).** Any mod drops `<ModRoot>/About/known-issues.json` (or `About/ModernDevTools.json`); scanned once at startup (`[StaticConstructorOnStartup]`) across all running mods, parsed via shared `CommunityData.ParseIssues`, matched via `CommunityData.Match(ctx,pool)`, credited to the shipping mod, ranked above community.
- **About.xml incompatibilities (`AboutIncompatIndex` + `Module_AboutIncompat`, always-on).** Reads every ACTIVE mod's `<incompatibleWith>`; when the error implicates one of an active pair, surfaces it, skipping pairs already covered by community rules.

**Author guide:** `Documentation/RootCauseAnalysis.md` (shipped; linked from the Extend hint + About).

### Community data (opt-in, `CommunityData`)
Off by default; background fetch, cached (embedded `Json`, gzip), offline fallback. Sources: RimSort Community Rules, Use This Instead, our own `known-issues.json`. `RepoOwner`/`RepoName` consts. `ParseIssues`/`Match` reused by `ModShippedIssues`.

### In-game reporting API + destination layering (`ReportBuilder`, `Dialog_Report`)
Server-less, secret-free. The report card opens the **composer** (`Dialog_Report`): read-only auto-collected block, editable fields (Bug: summary; Fix: explanation + "how did you fix it?" + credit), live preview.

**Report destination hierarchy** (`ReportBuilder.CulpritTarget` resolves the top installed culprit's channel): **Default → the culprit mod's OWN GitHub** (parse owner/repo from its About.xml `<url>`, open a pre-filled `issues/new?title&body`). **Fallback 1 → the culprit's Steam Workshop page** (`meta.OnSteamWorkshop`; workshop id = numeric `RootDir.Name`; can't pre-fill, so the report is copied to clipboard). **Fallback 2 → "Also report to community"** → our community Issue Form repo. `ReportToCulprit(target,title,body)` handles GitHub vs Workshop/site; `BugBody`/`FixBody` are the plain-issue markdown bodies.

**Signature** = FNV-1a over exception type + normalized top-6 frame types, `[#xxxxxxxx]` for dedup. URL builder `OpenAt(base,q,trimKeys…)` trims `details`/`body` under a ~6 KB budget. Repo side staged in `_dev/ModernDevTools/community-db/`.

### Tool 2: dev actions window (`Window_ModernDevActions`, 3-tab)
Reuses vanilla `DebugActionNode` graph so mod actions appear. `DebugActions_Testing` adds category "Modern Dev Tools" (order 50 → top): Log test message/warning/error, Throw test exception, Log burst, Log repeated error x5.

**Search (`SearchResults`).** Whole-tab, cached per (tab, search). **Breadth-first** traversal (`Queue`, depth cap 6, iteration guard 200000, result cap 400) so shallow root-level actions are always reached first — a prior depth-first walk dived into the huge Spawn/Try-place grids and exhausted its guard before ever reaching the direct "General" tools (e.g. `Destroy`, whose node label is `"T: Destroy"` — a `ToolMap` action with a `null` attribute name, added straight to the Actions root). Now **folder/category labels match too** (submenus are findable and drillable). The search box uses the themed `Palette.SearchField` and is **auto-focused on open and on tab switch** (`_focusSearch` flag → `GUI.FocusControl` after the field is drawn).

Spawn pickers render as a searchable icon grid; iconless actions fall back to the dev-action texture; every mod-supplied call is hardened (`DebugTree`) so a broken action cannot break the menu. Palette-pin path is `Actions\<label>`.

### Tool 3: dev palette (`Window_ModernDevPalette`)
Reskins `Dialog_DevPalette`.

### Updated-mod tracking + update notes
`GameComponent_ModSnapshot` diffs save's mods vs current → indicator → `Dialog_ModChanges`. `Dialog_UpdateNotes` once per Version.

### Experimental hardening (two toggles, off by default)
`WindowWatchdog` + `UiHardening` (world/map/global-controls OnGUI finalizers).

### Testing / environment note
Silent crashes during testing traced to **ReShade** (`dxgi.dll`) crashing on focus changes (alt-tab / browser launch), NOT the mod. Rename `dxgi.dll` to test cleanly.

### Localization
`Languages/English/Keyed/ModernDevTools.xml` (`MDT_*`, incl. `MDT_ReportToMod*`, `MDT_ReportToCommunity*`, `MDT_AboutIncompat*`, `MDT_ModShippedBy`, `MDT_ReasonLogPrefix`, `MDT_ReasonLogMention`); Def label/description DefInjected-translatable.

## GitHub Backup
Open source (MIT). Repo: **https://github.com/Astryls/ModernDevTools** (PUBLIC — the private-repo default is flipped for this mod). `origin` on the Astryls account; `Source/`, `Assemblies/*.dll`, and `.modmixer/` are tracked, `Source/**/{bin,obj}` ignored. Matches About.xml `<url>`. Community bug DB is CC0 so it can be mirrored freely.
